name: Simulator: downgrade credit (S27) shows $0.00 due, then $4.80 due on the next invoice
description: R10. A downgrade with always_invoice must never charge a negative amount: the credit is carried to the next invoice.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page and choose 'S27 · Downgrade with always_invoice creates a credit balance' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Assert the badge reads '✅ Matches golden expected'
Assert Invoice 2 (2027-01-17) has lines -$38.23 and $14.03, total -$24.20, and an 'Amount due' row showing exactly $0.00
Assert Invoice 3 (2027-02-01) total is $29.00, shows an 'Applied credit balance' row of -$24.20 and an 'Amount due' row of exactly $4.80
